description: This file defines the LoanTransactionRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor for managing LoanTransaction entities. It includes numerous custom query methods for retrieving, aggregating, and checking LoanTransaction data, with a focus on loan transactions, interest, charges, and transaction relationships within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanTransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanTransaction entity, providing methods for complex queries related to loan transactions, including interest, charges, transaction relationships, and status checks.

methods.name: findByIdAndLoanId
methods.description: Finds a LoanTransaction by its ID and associated Loan ID.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionsByTypeAndLessOrEqualDate
methods.description: Fetches loan transactions of a specific type up to a certain date, returning delinquency data.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal ID of a LoanTransaction given an external ID.

methods.name: fetchTotalUnpaidChargesForLoan
methods.description: Calculates total unpaid charges for a specific loan.

methods.name: findLoanIdById
methods.description: Finds the Loan ID associated with a specific LoanTransaction ID.

methods.name: findTotalUnrecognizedIncomeFromInterestWaiverByLoanAndDate
methods.description: Calculates total unrecognized income from interest waivers for a loan up to a specified date.

methods.name: findTotalInterestAccruedAmount
methods.description: Calculates total interest accrued for a loan.

methods.name: findAccrualInterestInPeriod
methods.description: Calculates interest accrued within a specific period for a loan.

methods.name: isChronologicallyLatest
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is the latest chronologically for a loan.

methods.name: findLastTransactionDateForReprocessing
methods.description: Finds the last transaction date suitable for reprocessing, excluding certain transaction types.

methods.name: findTransactionIdsByLoan
methods.description: Retrieves all transaction IDs for a loan.

methods.name: findReversedTransactionIdsByLoan
methods.description: Retrieves all reversed transaction IDs for a loan.

methods.name: findTransactionDataForForeclosureIncome
methods.description: Fetches transaction data relevant for foreclosure income calculations.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndDate
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions for a loan matching specific types and date.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndAfterDate
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions after a specific date for a loan and types.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypeAndAfterDate
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions for a loan of a specific type after a date.

methods.name: existsNonReversedByLoanAndTypeAndAfterDate
methods.description: Checks if non-reversed transactions of a specific type exist after a date for a loan.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypesAndNotInIds
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions excluding certain IDs.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypes
methods.description: Finds all non-reversed transactions for a loan of specific types.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndType
methods.description: Finds all non-reversed transactions for a loan of a specific type.

methods.name: findNonReversedByLoanAndTypeAndDate
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions for a loan of a specific type on a specific date.

methods.name: findCumulativeIncomeByLoanAndType
methods.description: Calculates cumulative income posting amounts for a loan.

methods.name: findChargeAccrualAmount
methods.description: Calculates the accrual amount for a specific charge.

methods.name: findChargeAccrualAmountByInstallment
methods.description: Calculates the accrual amount for a charge by installment.

methods.name: findChargeUnrecognizedWaivedAmount
methods.description: Calculates unrecognized waived amount for a charge up to a date.

methods.name: findLastNonReversedTransactionDateByLoanAndTypes
methods.description: Finds the last date of non-reversed transactions for a loan and specific types.

methods.name: findNonReversedLoanAndTypeAndDates
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions for a loan matching specific types and dates.

methods.name: findNonReversedLoanAndTypeAndDate
methods.description: Finds non-reversed transactions for a loan of a specific type on a specific date.

methods.name: findReversedTransactionIdsByLoan
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of reversed transactions for a loan.

methods.name: calculateTotalRecoveryPaymentAmount
methods.description: Calculates total recovery payment amount for a loan.

methods.name: fetchClassificationCodeValueByTransactionId
methods.description: Fetches classification code value for a transaction.
